name: natyv Stylesheet
comment: Syntax highlighting only, mirroring src/styling/Stylesheet.zig's real grammar (token { field: value }, '//' line comments, no string escapes). Misspelled field names/values are still only caught by `natyv prepare` itself, not by this grammar -- see CLAUDE.md's LSP section for the separate, larger effort that would be needed for live diagnostics.

token-name.comment: A bare identifier immediately followed by '{' with no colon in between only ever occurs at a top-level `name { ... }` declaration -- every nested block value is always introduced by `key: {`, caught by #field-key first.

patterns.comment: Hex colors (#RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA) get their own scope so a theme can color-swatch or at least visually distinguish them from plain text values.
patterns.name: constant.other.color.ntss

bare-ident.comment: A bare identifier that isn't a token name or field key -- anchor keywords (top/bottomRight/...) and any other bare-word value.
bare-ident.name: constant.language.ntss
